description: A Redshift authentication profile: connection options that JDBC and ODBC clients read by the profile's name, made with Redshift's CreateAuthenticationProfile. AWS rejects a profile that holds secrets, such as SecretAccessKey or Password.

AuthenticationProfileName.description: The name of the profile. It is case sensitive. Radius generates one when the template leaves it out.

AuthenticationProfileContent.description: The connection options, as a JSON object whose values are strings, numbers, or booleans, such as {"AllowDBUserOverride": "1", "App_ID": "example"}. AWS stores each value as a string and drops null values.
